Describe pairwise impact interactions

Source: R/inputs.R
cm_interactions.Rd

An interaction delta is the additional impact when both diseases are present, in the same units as the impact vector: positive values are synergistic (more than the sum), negative values antagonistic. Interactions cannot be inferred from associations and must come from evidence or explicit scenarios. A model with interactions is always adjusted with the global method (see deconflate()). Interactions apply to additive impacts only.

Usage

cm_interactions(disease1, disease2, value, source = NA_character_)

Arguments

disease1, disease2

Character vectors of disease ids.

value

Numeric interaction values (same units as the impacts).

source

Optional citation or scenario label.

Value

A cm_interactions data frame.

Examples

cm_interactions("d1", "d2", 0.5)
#>   disease1 disease2 value source
#> 1       d1       d2   0.5   <NA>
